classRulings.recorded-teachings: EXCLUDED as a class (owner, Aug 28): a recorded lecture is not music, whoever the speaker. Sorted by CATALOG, never by the title lama — chant and sung ritual ARE music (lesson-7 discipline).
classRulings.monastery-ensembles: Owner test (Aug 28): a TIBETAN institution (exile re-establishments included) is in; a non-Tibetan institution practicing Tibetan Buddhism is not — religion is not ethnic identity.
